provisioning.scope: Install this bootstrap binary and unit from the trusted node image or operator-delivered bootstrap package, outside the active release generation.
provisioning.trust: Provision root:root public-key documents under /etc/cyberpanel/node-release/trust.d and retain historical documents while their previous releases remain rollback candidates.
provisioning.bundle: Copy one exact-target signed .tar to a root-owned, singly linked local path with no group/other write permission; panel-node-install never downloads or resolves a missing artifact.
provisioning.recovery: Enable panel-node-release-reconcile.service before the first apply so interrupted journals are re-observed and converged automatically on boot.
